column1: # target: Pokémon Legends: Arceus v262144 NPC and NPC-Pokémon placements (resident_release.gfpak placement kinds npc, npc_pokemon)
# note: One row per placement VARIANT: an NPC record (key) has 1..n variants (field 4); which one is active is chosen by its condition.
# note: x,y,z area-local metres (same frame as field_object_placements); rot_* degrees (only rot_y seen non-zero); scale (always 1 seen).
# note: chara_hash = FNV-1a 64 of the character id = data/npc_appearance.hash (recipe). For npc_pokemon it keys the NPC-Pokemon table
# note: (resident entry found by content): chara_id = `species <national dex id> form <n> <sex>` (sex spelling as in the data).
# note: cond_kind/cond_op: hashes resolved to names where a candidate matched exactly (time_zone, equal, between...); else the raw hash.
# note: cond_role: the resolved name, or a LIKELY role inferred from the flag names tested (quest_progress, story_phase_work, flag, work, default).
# note: cond_name = story/system flag or work name (WPHA_STORY, FSYS_*, sub_NNN); values are kept raw: story gates are NOT decoded.
# note: talk_hash = record field 3 (u64, unresolved; LIKELY the talk/interaction id); text is out of scope.
# note: face_a/face_b = behaviour f17/f18 facial expression names (VERIFIED hash match; which is talk vs idle is unknown).
# note: link = behaviour f20 linked placement key; tag = behaviour f22 string; beh_raw = other behaviour scalars, meaning unknown.
